issue_context.title: Bug: Custom font not used in item preview pane
issue_context.body:
### Description

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/110698934/230771125-7e11d0fa-35d0-45b5-9039-c5d82f3067f6.png)
The underlined bits of text are not using the font set in the Settings file

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Set a custom font
2. Open the preview pane

### Requirements

A custom font to be set

### Files Version

2.4.61.0

### Windows Version

10.0.25336.1000

### Log file

[debug.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/11185352/debug.log)
comments: @i-dont-know-username thank you for reporting this issue.

While looking at this and the other custom font issue I noticed that the Details page uses custom fonts and the general page only partially does. Neither the security or Hashes page use any custom fonts. I'm assuming all the pages should be using custom fonts for all the text? Or is it by design? Thanks! I've attached two images to show what I mean. If this is a totally separate issue I can open one up.

![Files_Properties](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26210780/235283429-d99f1fca-be3d-4a80-b7dd-271332e4174c.png)
![Files_General](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26210780/235283452-f20f363d-9830-4397-b84e-9a20134c7ef7.png)
Possible to be assigned to this issue please?
@MrFrawsty I'm creating a new issue for the inconsistencies you've seen in the Properties window that are actually existant on a wider scale : #12553
This issue will be fixed in the upcoming v2.5 release.
